name: dev-setup
description: One setup for the delivery flow: /setup asks your role (product owner, designer, developer, tech lead, or all) for all projects or one repository, and the facts of the project, and writes .claude/rules/delivery.md, REVIEW.md, a pull request template, and a CI check. /setup route changes the steps of your route. /setup starter makes the Claude Code basics of a project. A session-start hook gives each session your role. Output in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English or Begrijpelijk Nederlands (B1).
